diagram_previews.alt: A blue circle, a red square with the same centre whose corners stick out of the circle, and a green equilateral triangle with the same centre pointing up. Each side of the square and of the triangle cuts the circle twice, each side of the triangle cuts the square twice, and the 20 crossing points are marked with dots.
